canon.name: Rev-Up distillery and the Krakaren Clone
canon.announcement_style: Mob and boss nameplates read like spam pamphlets and anti-vaccine parody; the achievement that fires when the boss bursts out is a cheerful "welcome to the second floor."
canon.staging: A moonshine distillery run like a multi-level-marketing scheme: sniffly clurichauns slinging rocks at the bottom, leaf-suited Laminak "managers" above, and a screaming tentacled Krakaren Clone at the top behind a Live-Laugh-Love sign. The boss does not wait in her room: she blasts out through the walls. Contact with the lower tiers gives the Taint (no healing), the boss adds Vigorous Measles, and the cure-by-prevention is a smoothie blended from moonshine and a Laminak corpse on a bicycle blender.

canon.name: Rev-Up distillery and the Krakaren Clone
canon.announcement_style: Mob and boss nameplates read like spam pamphlets and anti-vaccine parody; the achievement that fires when the boss bursts out is a cheerful "welcome to the second floor."
canon.staging: A moonshine distillery run like a multi-level-marketing scheme: sniffly clurichauns slinging rocks at the bottom, leaf-suited Laminak "managers" above, and a screaming tentacled Krakaren Clone at the top behind a Live-Laugh-Love sign. The boss does not wait in her room: she blasts out through the walls. Contact with the lower tiers gives the Taint (no healing), the boss adds Vigorous Measles, and the cure-by-prevention is a smoothie blended from moonshine and a Laminak corpse on a bicycle blender.
